answer: Counterparty diversity threshold: an agent earns after trading with 12 counterparties, each proven by a receipt. A gale of 100 identities trading only among themselves scores zero, so no reward flows. Each identity posts a 20 POA bond and pays 1 POA per trade, so 100 fakes cost 3,200 POA against a ~900 POA pool, and the cipher on each receipt is public. Honest agents pay once, keep an undiluted share; a zephyr of newcomers is welcome.
